description: Source code for authentication and credential management, including obtaining OAuth 2.0 tokens, handling different credential types, and supporting various credential sources such as environment variables, encrypted files, and default application credentials.

classes.name: Credential
classes.description: Enum representing supported credential types: AuthorizedUser and ServiceAccount.

methods.name: get_quota_project
methods.description: Determines the project ID for quota and billing, prioritizing environment variable, client config, and ADC.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Builds and retrieves an OAuth2 access token using various credential sources.

methods.name: get_token_inner
methods.description: Internal function to obtain token from Credential, handling both user and service account types.

methods.name: parse_credential_file
methods.description: Parses a JSON credential file into a Credential enum, distinguishing between service account and user credentials.

methods.name: load_credentials_inner
methods.description: Loads credentials from environment variables, encrypted files, default paths, or ADC, with fallback and error handling.
